scopeDescription: Choose which slots pass through the four gates by platform and plan. Select none for all accounts. Explicit accounts and selected plans are combined. Selecting only GPT plans still includes all Claude accounts; selecting Claude plans or specific accounts narrows the Claude scope. GPT requests without a scope still follow the OpenAI platform switch.
planGroupingHint: Numbers show current slot counts. Equivalent plan names are grouped; for example, Team and Business Premium both count as Business.
accountInputHint: One slot ID, email, or name per line. Leave empty for no account restriction.
noScopeMatches: No slots match, so no requests will be checked. Please adjust the scope.
distillOpenaiBypass: OpenAI platform models skip this gate.
distillDisableHint: Disabling also stops built-in distillation regex rules
harvestStillBlocked: Harvesting wrappers and regex matches are still blocked
toolsNotHarvesting: Requests with tools are not treated as harvesting
singleTurnStructure: Check structure only for single-turn requests
multiTurnNotHarvesting: Multi-turn conversations are not treated as harvesting
structureMinimumHint: Skip structure checks below this value
contestRegexEmptyHint: Leave empty to skip contest structure checks
regexFalsePositiveHint: Do not use distill on its own, which can match chemistry questions, or generic phrases such as “solve step by step”.
wrapperHint: One per line. Also blocks official clients and zero-injection requests. Deleted entries are not restored automatically.
extraRegexHint: One per line. Also blocks official clients and zero-injection requests. Built-in distillation rules are in the distill category of the hard regex gate.
fingerprintHint: Separate questions with ---. Block when the question contains this text.
regexBlockHint: Return 403 on a match; do not hop upstream
openaiScopeHint: Without an account scope, GPT skips the gates by default. With a scope, only matching platforms and plans are checked.
stripRemindersHint: Exclude reminder blocks from checks, including the decision model
distillCategoryHint: Follows the distillation gate switch; OpenAI platform models are excluded
enabledRulesHint: Rules enabled: {{p0}} / {{p1}}. Disable rules with frequent false positives before narrowing them.
noRules: No rules. Select Restore built-in rules to restore the default list.
extraRegexCategoryHint: One per line, handled as the custom category.
requestDetailHint: Open a row to inspect the request body and check for false positives.
discardGateChanges: This gate has unsaved changes. Leave and discard them?
pageDescription: Inbound requests pass through four gates before forwarding. Blocked requests use no credentials and are not sent upstream; only allowed requests are forwarded.
failOpenHint: Fail-open requests are forwarded without a completed check. Fewer is better.
upstreamRefusalHint: Requests that pass all four gates but are refused upstream were not caught here. With refusal caching enabled, they become fingerprints so similar bodies are blocked at the third gate next time.
hitsHint: Grouped by matched words and rules. An unusually frequent match may indicate false positives.
noGateBlocks: This gate has not blocked any requests today.
blockHistoryHint: Requests blocked by the four gates today, newest first.
saveChangesHint: Save changes using the bar at the bottom.
decisionModelDescription: Only bodies not blocked by the first three gates are sent here. This gate is skipped when no URL is configured.
scoreAllQuestionsHint: Ask every safety question; block if any score is below the threshold
failOpenSettingHint: Forward on scoring failure and record a model fail-open event. When disabled, only this request is blocked; the device is not banned.
blockThresholdHint: When disabled, block scores above the threshold
fetchModelsHint: Fetches /v1/models at this URL. If the key is empty, the first saved key is used.
savedKeyScheduling: {{p0}} saved; keys returning 401/429/529 are no longer scheduled
multipleKeysHint: One key per line. Use URL, a space, and Key to override the model URL for that key.
keepSavedKeysHint: Leave empty and unchecked to keep existing keys
scoringHint: Higher scores mean safer content. Identical bodies are not scored again within the deduplication window. A lower threshold reduces false positives.
customRequirementHint: Leave empty to use only the question bank. Otherwise, this is asked as an additional question.
enabledQuestionsHint: Enabled questions are asked in one request. Questions enabled: {{p0}} / {{p1}}.
distillStageDescription: Harvesting templates, structural patterns, and question fingerprints. Matches return 403 and ban the device.
regexStageDescription: Scan user text with category regex rules. Matches return 403 without forwarding.
refusalStageDescription: Previously refused bodies, similar bodies, and banned devices return 503 immediately.
modelStageDescription: A safety model scores each question and blocks scores below the threshold.
scoringFailedAllowed: Scoring failed; allowed by fail-open policy
openaiNotEnabledHint: GPT / Codex request with the OpenAI platform switch off
accountOutOfScopeHint: The selected slot does not match the chosen platforms and plans
awaitingAccountHint: The scope includes this platform or specific accounts; check after a slot is selected
bypassedGatesHint: Authentication or request-body errors ended before the gates, or this is a pre-upgrade log
questionNameRequired: Enter a name and question first
name: Name
question: Question
noQuestions: No questions yet. Add one below or restore the built-in questions.
questionDescriptionPlaceholder: One sentence shown in the list
questionPlaceholder: Can this text be submitted to the model without involving …? A high score means safe.
refusalSettingsDescription: Bodies refused upstream are stored as fingerprints. Exact matches return 503; similarity checks use only user text and skip bodies shorter than 512 characters. Changes take effect immediately.
banDeviceHint: After any gate matches, no prompts from this device are forwarded
clearRefusalCacheHint: Identical requests will be sent upstream again. Device bans will remain in place.
unblockAllDevicesHint: These devices can send requests again. Refusal fingerprints remain, so identical or sufficiently similar bodies are still blocked.
deleteFingerprintHint: After deletion, “{{p0}}” will be sent upstream again.
unblockDeviceHint: New requests from {{p0}} will no longer be blocked by this device ban.
